title: Remove stray __init__.py that crashes the photo-vectorizer mypy gate
intent: The photo-vectorizer typecheck job fails with 'photo-vectorizer contains __init__.py but is not a valid Python package name' (exit code 2) - a hard mypy error that aborts before any analysis runs, so the gate has been reporting failure without ever checking a single type. The marker file is inert: 'import photo-vectorizer' is a SyntaxError, no importlib/pkgutil reference targets it, every consumer imports these modules as top-level modules via sys.path, and its whole content is one comment line. Deleting it lets mypy actually run. Pre-existing since ffecf39f (rebrand); latent because the workflow is path-filtered, and surfaced only when PR #232 became the first PR since to touch that directory.
behavior_change: No runtime behavior change - the deleted file is a single comment and cannot function as a package marker under a hyphenated directory name. CI behavior changes materially: the mypy job stops aborting at exit code 2 and now performs real analysis. That analysis reports 168 pre-existing type errors across 15 files, which were previously masked by the crash. This patch does NOT fix those errors and does not make the job green; it makes the job truthful. See known_residual.

diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Without it the mypy gate cannot run at all. Verified inert before deletion: the directory name contains a hyphen so it can never be imported as a package; no importlib/pkgutil/find_spec reference targets it; and the real import sites (edge_to_dxf_router.py, blueprint_extract.py) use top-level `from edge_to_dxf import ...` via sys.path, not package member access.

commands_run: python -c "import ast; ast.parse('import photo-vectorizer')" -> SyntaxError, confirming the directory can never be a package.
git grep for importlib/pkgutil/import_module/find_spec against photo-vectorizer -> no references.
git grep for actual import sites -> 'from edge_to_dxf import ...' top-level imports only.

mypy NOT run locally: mypy is not installed in the available environment. CI is the check. CI confirms the error changed from exit code 2 (crash, nothing analysed) to exit code 1 with 168 real errors, which is the intended effect of this change.
verification.known_residual: The mypy job is still RED after this change, and deliberately so. It now reports 168 pre-existing type errors in 15 files (photo_vectorizer_v2.py 70, test_extract_coach_integration.py 41, march_pipeline_restore.py 16, photo_silhouette_extractor.py 10, geometry_coach_v2.py 8, and others). None are introduced here. Going green requires an owner decision: pay the debt, or adopt an error-count baseline ratchet consistent with the existing ci/file_size_baseline.json and ci/router_count_baseline.json pattern. Filed rather than hidden.

files.intent: Delete an inert package marker in a hyphenated directory that makes mypy abort with a hard error before analysing anything.
files.behavior_change: No runtime effect - the file is a single comment and the directory can never be imported as a package. CI effect: the mypy job stops crashing and begins real analysis.
